mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 4.5% over three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales growth signal a weakening consumer demand environment, triggering a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue expectations are revised downward, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 60-day returns in >60% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of rising industrial production growth, manufacturing output expansion supports corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >55% of INDPRO growth periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained CPI inflation rate above 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive monetary policy, which depresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in >55% of CPIAUCSL >3.5% periods, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in non-farm payrolls exceeding 50,000 jobs signals a weakening labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in >55% of PAYEMS decline periods, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in GDP growth and retail sales growth signal a broad-based economic slowdown, triggering a risk-off sentiment that depresses equity prices, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint GDPC1 and RSAFS decline fails to produce negative 5-day returns in >60% of cases, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production, manufacturing contraction signals reduced corporate output and profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in >55% of INDPRO decline periods, or Rank IC < 0.03.
